scope: Partner Customization skill relationship validator integrity against the live canonical skill and character identity corpora

validator_correction.issue: The validator previously attempted to read row.skill_id from docs/data/skills.json, but the canonical corpus stores the stable identifier in row.id.
validator_correction.correction: Changed the validator to build its canonical ID set from row.id. No canonical skill records were changed.
validator_correction.validation_basis: The live 474-record skills corpus contains id=skill-arm-crash and id=skill-reverse-mabakusenko; all three relationship pairs are unique and carry repository evidence.
validator_correction.evidence_validation: Validator now also verifies every declared evidence path exists in the live repository tree; all 6 declared evidence files are present.

evidence_boundary: This validates relationship-layer schema, canonical skill-ID reachability, canonical partner-name reachability, uniqueness, and evidence-path existence. It does not infer additional Partner Customization assignments, DLC ownership, raid availability, or skill mechanics.

changes: Build canonical partner-name set from character-id-identity-bridge.json.
Reject relationship rows whose partner_name is not a canonical character name.
Retain canonical skill-ID, uniqueness, relationship-type, and evidence-path checks.
Require exactly 3 canonical relationship records; require object-shaped records, list-shaped evidence, and non-empty string evidence paths.
Reject a malformed relationship source container instead of treating non-object input as implicitly valid.
Reject malformed skills.records and character bridge records containers or record shapes.
Require canonical skill IDs and partner names used by the validator to be non-empty strings.
